mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) as totalQuantity, SUM(oi.subtotal) as totalSales FROM biz_order_item oi INNER JOIN biz_product p ON oi.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN biz_sales_order o ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name, p.category ORDER BY totalSales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
